g.text: How long the analyzer actually takes
AppRequests | where Name == "AnalysisStatus" | summarize polls = count() by run
| extend minutes = polls * 10.5 / 60 → one lap of the dial = 12 min
PT1H = five laps of this dial.
The old PT10M limit stopped the flow at the red line.
One hour of patience is five full laps.
> 12 successful analyses · typical run 2–3 min · 1 outlier_
